home.metaDescription: Book a first video visit with a US board certified doctor who speaks Arabic. Licence checked, price shown before you book.
home.title: US-trained, Arabic-speaking doctors, for you
home.subtitle: Book a first video visit with a US board certified doctor who speaks your language.
home.searchLabel: Search for a specialty, condition or doctor
home.noSuggestions: No match yet. Press Search to look through all doctors.
home.askChat: Not sure which specialty? Ask our assistant
home.doctorsLead: Every doctor here holds a US licence that we checked ourselves. Tap a card to see the back.
home.doctorsEmptyBody: The first profiles are being checked. Browse the specialties to see who is coming.
home.stepsLead: Three steps. No account needed to browse.
home.step1Body: Search by specialty or condition. Every profile shows training, languages and the first-visit price.
home.step2Body: Pick a time shown in your own time zone and pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
home.step3Body: Meet by video or phone. Upload your records before the visit so the doctor has already read them.
home.legalTitle: How a US doctor can see you
home.legalBody: Your doctor is licensed in the United States and consults you from there by video. The visit is a first consultation and a second opinion: the doctor explains your condition, reviews your records and recommends next steps. It is not an emergency service and does not replace your local physician.
home.faq1Q: Do I need to travel to the US?
home.faq1A: No. You join the visit from home in your country, by video or phone.
home.faq2Q: What does US board certified mean?
home.faq2A: The doctor passed a national specialty exam after residency, on top of the licence every doctor needs. We check both.
home.faq3Q: How much does a first visit cost?
home.faq3A: Each doctor sets one price, shown on the profile before you book. There is nothing to pay until you book.
home.ctaBody: Browse verified doctors and book your first visit in minutes.

about.metaDescription: Who runs 3affya, how we check every doctor's US licence and board certification, and how to reach us.
about.title: About 3affya
about.intro1: 3affya connects patients in the Gulf with doctors who trained in the United States and speak Arabic. You find a doctor, see one clear price and book a first video visit in your own language.
about.intro2: We are not a clinic. Each doctor is licensed in the US and is responsible for the care they give you. 3affya checks their papers, takes the booking and payment, and helps you get your medical records ready before the visit.
about.founderPending: Photo and short biography: added before launch.
about.verifyLead: A doctor can take bookings only after our team has checked their papers.
about.verify1Body: Every US doctor has an entry in a public registry. A page built only from that entry is labelled as such and cannot take bookings.
about.verify2Body: To claim the page, the doctor uploads their US state licence and their board certificate.
about.verify3Body: We check the licence with the state medical board and the certificate with the board that issued it. Only then does the profile show this badge, with the date we checked.
about.checkLead: These public sites are run by US medical bodies, not by 3affya.
about.checkBoardBy: By the American Board of Medical Specialties
about.checkLicenceBy: By the Federation of State Medical Boards
about.entityValue: A US company now being registered. Its legal name and registration number appear here once registration is complete.
about.contactBody: A question about a doctor, a booking or this site? Send us a message.
